2026-11-21: Release 0.6.0. Every codec gains a slow rung between the Default and the former slow (now slower; veryslow on HEVC and VVC), the Default plus a gated RD partition search; VVC gains a fast rung (the former fast is now faster), and H.264's fast end is re-pointed along the front (the former fast is now faster, the former faster retired).

The zero-trial split selector on most Defaults and fast rungs; temporal layer propagation on flat streams (HEVC slow/veryslow, VVC Default/slow, AV1 slow/slower, AV2 Default); loop-filter search effort by usage; rate-aware coefficient trimming (quant.rd_trim) on the fast rungs; a held second reference (AV1 and VP9 slow).
